card.name: The first name John before a surname
card.fires_on: The first name "John" (or its initial) when it is followed by a surname, usually in author bylines, copyright lines and names of scientists or public figures.

modes.label: Author byline or credit
modes.description: John begins an author's name after "By", "by" or "ABOUT THE AUTHORS".
modes.example: Ethernet arose from Aloha Net By<< John>> Rinaldi and Perry Marshall Ethernet

modes.label: Named person in text
modes.description: John starts the name of a scientist, artist or commentator mentioned in the body.
modes.example: renowned mathematician<< John>> von Neumannâs implementation of Alan

modes.label: Possessive or middle initial
modes.description: A "John's" form or the period after a middle initial in a name.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward a surname or name continuation and away from ordinary words.
card.plain: It lights up on the first name John when a surname is about to follow, especially in author credits.
